title: MercadoLibre's AI Investments Are Set to Drive the Next Growth Chapter
author: Zacks.Com
description: MercadoLibre increased AI investments by approximately $80 million year-over-year in Q2 2026, with the technology delivering tangible returns across development and marketplace operations. AI-powered search improved conversion and click-through rates while offsetting third-party LLM costs, and the company achieved operating efficiencies with Product Development expenses declining to 7.2% of revenues despite higher AI spending. The stock trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 37.18 and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company demonstrated significant AI investments yielding tangible returns including improved conversion rates, developer productivity gains (110% increase in code submissions, 75% rise in deployments), and operational efficiencies (Product Development expenses fell despite higher AI spending). However, positive sentiment is tempered by premium valuation and Hold rating.

title: Dlocal's 2026 Outlook: Soaring Total Payment Volume Meets a Reasonable Valuation
author: Josh Kohn-Lindquist
description: Dlocal (DLO) receives a Superscore of 77/100, indicating strong fundamentals driven by 92% year-over-year TPV growth, 153% net revenue retention, and an asset-light business model. However, the stock faces headwinds from 61% revenue concentration among top 10 merchants, margin compression from 53% to 37% since 2021, and a fairly valued P/E of 21.7. Trading at $14.95, the stock could outperform if management successfully stabilizes take rates with enterprise clients.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong operational metrics including 92% TPV growth, 153% NRR, and 63% profit surge in 2025 demonstrate robust business execution. Asset-light model and regulatory moats in emerging markets provide durable competitive advantages. Current valuation at 17.4x forward earnings appears reasonable relative to growth trajectory.

title: Is MercadoLibre Becoming Latin America's Leading Fintech?
author: Na
description: MercadoLibre's fintech segment Mercado Pago demonstrated strong growth in Q2 2026, with monthly active users surging 30% to 88 million, AUM jumping 68% to $23.2 billion, and total payment volume reaching $101 billion. The credit portfolio expanded 75% to $16.4 billion with stable asset quality. However, MELI stock trades at a premium valuation (P/E of 39.01) compared to industry peers, and recent earnings estimates have declined.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong operational metrics including 30% user growth, 68% AUM growth, 56% payment volume increase, and stable asset quality demonstrate robust business expansion and market leadership in Latin America's fintech sector.
Mentioned as a competitor with modest share gains (5.4% over three months) and lower valuation multiples (P/E 22.76) compared to MELI, indicating stable but less dynamic performance.

title: 2 Monster Stocks to Hold for the Next 10 Years
author: Jennifer Saibil
description: The article recommends Costco Wholesale and MercadoLibre as two stocks suitable for long-term 10-year holding periods. Costco demonstrates strong performance with 11.6% sales growth, 82.9 million members, and plans for 30+ annual store openings. MercadoLibre, an e-commerce and fintech platform in Latin America, shows 50% revenue growth and 36% GMV increase, with ecosystemic users generating significantly higher value metrics.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong comparable sales growth (9.8%, largest since pandemic start), consistent membership growth (4.1% YoY), high executive member adoption (9.6% increase), and expansion plans (30+ stores annually) demonstrate durable competitive advantages and robust growth trajectory.

Exceptional growth metrics including 50% revenue growth, 36% GMV increase, 26% unique buyer growth, and 37% ecosystemic user growth. Ecosystemic users generate 70% more GMV and significantly higher fintech engagement, indicating strong platform network effects and substantial untapped market opportunity in underpenetrated Latin American e-commerce and fintech sectors.

title: Netflix, MercadoLibre, and Tesla Are All Underperforming the S&P 500. Here's the 1 Stock I'd Buy in September.
author: Rick Munarriz
description: Netflix, MercadoLibre, and Tesla are underperforming the S&P 500 in 2026, down 14%, 3%, and 21% respectively. Despite challenges, all three companies continue growing. The author recommends buying MercadoLibre in September, citing its strong growth trajectory in Latin American e-commerce and fintech markets at a reasonable valuation, while avoiding Tesla due to its rich valuation and uncertain robotics payoff.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Revenue growth is decelerating from 18% to 11.7%, but valuation is now compelling at 25x trailing earnings. Strong profitability growth offsets slowing top-line expansion. Not recommended for September purchase due to slowest growth among the three.

Recommended as the top pick for September. Demonstrates consistent 30%+ quarterly revenue growth with 50% growth in latest quarter. Despite near-term margin pressures from market expansion, the company is well-positioned in early-stage Latin American e-commerce and fintech markets. Trading at reasonable 35x forward earnings given historical growth rates.
